source.license_note: Repository LICENSE and the paper state MIT, but Scripts/IFAM.R carries a GPL-3.0 header. Do not vendor or redistribute the script until this conflict is resolved; this contract only pins the upstream entrypoint.

path_policy.root: Every path is relative to the server's read-only input mount; absolute paths and parent traversal are rejected.
path_policy.characters: Paths and annotation stems must use only letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen, and slash, with no whitespace or shell metacharacters. Upstream IFAM.R interpolates some values into shell commands.
path_policy.writes: The server writes only to a fresh per-job output directory.

tools.name: ifam_inspect_inputs
tools.title: Inspect IFAM inputs
tools.description: Read-only validation of a PLINK binary set, phenotype file, auto-discovered annotation folder, optional special annotation, and an optional validation split. Returns counts, ID alignment, annotation coverage and overlap, genotype missingness, blocking errors, and warnings. Does not fit a model.

input_root.description: Dataset directory relative to the read-only input mount. All other paths are relative to this directory.

bfile.description: PLINK binary prefix relative to input_root, without .bed/.bim/.fam.

phenotype.description: Fit-ready phenotype file relative to input_root. Header row required; column 1 is the individual ID; the selected phenotype column may contain NA.

phenotype_index.description: 1-based phenotype column index passed to IFAM as --pheno_pos. The selected header must be a safe filename component (letters, digits, dot, underscore, hyphen).

annotation_dir.description: Directory relative to input_root containing one-column, headerless .txt SNP lists. IFAM.R auto-discovers every *.txt directly in this directory; do not add an annotation_names.txt manifest.

special_annotations.description: Annotation stems without .txt, passed to IFAM --anno_spec. At most one is supported in upstream IFAM.R 1.0.0; the multiple-special path is broken and must not be claimed.

random_max.description: Planned IFAM --randomMax. Special annotations count against this cap; must be greater than the number of special annotations.

validation_split.description: Optional split JSON relative to input_root. When supplied, validation IDs must be present and masked as NA in the fit phenotype, and train/validation IDs must not overlap.

tools.name: ifam_fit
tools.title: Fit IFAM
tools.description: Submit an IFAM fit through the pinned IFAM.R 1.0.0 script and HIBLUP v1.1.0 on an isolated worker. Returns immediately with a job_id. The server validates inputs, builds annotation GRMs, estimates variance components, merges random effects, and predicts genetic values. At most one special annotation is supported. It does not compute held-out metrics.

bfile.description: PLINK binary prefix relative to input_root, without .bed/.bim/.fam.

phenotype.description: Fit-ready phenotype file; header row required, column 1 is the individual ID; the selected phenotype column may contain NA and its header must be a safe filename component.

phenotype_index.description: 1-based phenotype column index passed to IFAM as --pheno_pos.

annotation_dir.description: Directory of headerless one-column .txt annotation files; every *.txt is auto-discovered, with no manifest.

validation_split.description: Optional split JSON relative to input_root. The job is blocked when any validation ID has a non-NA value in the fit phenotype. Held-out truth is never accepted by this tool or any other MCP tool; the independent runner holds it.

random_max.description: IFAM --randomMax. Special annotations count against this cap; the effective optimization cap is random_max minus the number of special annotations.

threads.description: IFAM --thread; the worker enforces a lower site limit when necessary.

keep_intermediate.description: Retain HIBLUP intermediate files in the job directory after the wrapper parses outputs. The wrapper always invokes IFAM.R with --tmp_files TRUE to avoid upstream's wildcard cleanup, then applies this retention rule itself. Primary outputs are always preserved.

tools.name: ifam_job_status
tools.title: Check IFAM job
tools.description: Read the state, phase, progress, error, and artifact inventory of a submitted IFAM job. Polling this tool does not alter the job.

progress.description: Best-effort progress parsed from IFAM/HIBLUP logs; not a scientific result.

tools.name: ifam_export
tools.title: Export IFAM predictions
tools.description: Normalize a completed IFAM job into benchmark-ready predictions and provenance. Metrics are intentionally absent: the independent benchmark runner computes Pearson r, AUC, and prediction bias from these predictions, the held-out truth, and the recorded split. When a split was supplied at fit time, the export verifies that predictions cover every validation ID.

split_id.description: Split recorded at fit time; null when no validation split was supplied.
